arguments.heading: What happened at the argument
paragraphs: Florida's lawyer argued Georgia's consumption is unreasonable. He said a cap is the only fix.
Georgia's lawyer argued Florida failed to prove its case. He said a cap alone will not increase water flow.
Justices questioned whether Florida proved its harm. They asked about the evidence in the record.
